ex.en: Do you have your student identification card?
ex.zh: 你有帶學生證嗎？

ex.en: Please bring a valid form of identification.
ex.zh: 請攜帶有效的身分證明文件。

ex.en: Early identification of problems saves time and money.
ex.zh: 及早發現問題可以省時又省錢。

ex.en: The identification of the missing files took hours.
ex.zh: 找出遺失的檔案花了好幾個小時。

ex.en: Ideally, a candidate for this job should have four years' work experience.
ex.zh: 理想情況下，這份工作的應徵者應具備四年工作經驗。

ex.en: Ideally, we should finish the project by Friday.
ex.zh: 理想的話，我們應該在星期五前完成這個專案。

ex.en: The hotel is ideally located near the station.
ex.zh: 這家飯店位置絕佳，就在車站附近。

ex.en: She is ideally suited for the job.
ex.zh: 她非常適合這份工作。

identical.zh: 完全相同的、一模一樣的

ex.en: He is identical to his older brother.
ex.zh: 他和哥哥長得一模一樣。

ex.en: The two reports are almost identical.
ex.zh: 這兩份報告幾乎一模一樣。

ex.en: They are identical twins.
ex.zh: 他們是同卵雙胞胎。

ex.en: It's wasteful to leave the land lying idle.
ex.zh: 讓土地閒置很浪費。

ex.en: Half of the machines in the factory are idle.
ex.zh: 工廠裡有一半的機器閒置著。

ex.en: Jim works hard, but John is idle.
ex.zh: 吉姆工作努力，約翰卻無所事事。

ex.en: No matter how rich a man may be, he ought not to be idle.
ex.zh: 一個人無論多有錢，都不應該遊手好閒。

ex.en: Don't leave your car engine idling.
ex.zh: 不要讓車子引擎一直怠速空轉。

ex.en: The bus idled outside the hotel.
ex.zh: 巴士在飯店外怠速等候。

ex.en: The two parties have deep ideological differences.
ex.zh: 兩黨之間有很深的意識形態分歧。

ex.en: Their disagreement is more ideological than practical.
ex.zh: 他們的分歧與其說是實務上的，不如說是理念上的。

ex.en: The heart of Esperanto ideology is the equality of all languages and cultures.
ex.zh: 世界語理念的核心是所有語言和文化一律平等。

ex.en: The party's ideology has changed over time.
ex.zh: 這個政黨的意識形態隨著時間改變了。

ex.en: How did you come up with this crazy idea?
ex.zh: 你是怎麼想到這麼瘋狂的主意的？

ex.en: Get rid of those kinds of naive ideas.
ex.zh: 別再有那種天真的想法了。

ex.en: That's a great idea!
ex.zh: 這是個好主意！

ex.en: I have no idea why she got so angry.
ex.zh: 我不知道她為什麼那麼生氣。

ex.en: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
ex.zh: 你知道銀行幾點關門嗎？

ex.en: This chart will give you an idea of our sales.
ex.zh: 這張圖表能讓你大致了解我們的業績。

ex.en: Can you give me a rough idea of the cost?
ex.zh: 你能告訴我大概的費用嗎？

ex.en: You can identify children's voices without any problem.
ex.zh: 你可以毫不費力地辨認出孩子們的聲音。

ex.en: She identified him as the murderer.
ex.zh: 她指認他就是兇手。

ex.en: They identified the risk factors.
ex.zh: 他們找出了風險因素。

ex.en: We need to identify the cause of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們需要找出問題的原因。

ex.en: Many viewers identify with the main character.
ex.zh: 許多觀眾對主角很有共鳴。

ex.en: I can really identify with her feelings.
ex.zh: 我很能體會她的感受。

ex.en: Sir, please present your passport or identity card, so I can register it.
ex.zh: 先生，請出示護照或身分證，讓我幫您登記。

ex.en: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
ex.zh: 學生不應該忘了自己的身分。

ex.en: Please bring a photo ID to prove your identity.
ex.zh: 請攜帶附照片的證件以證明身分。

ex.en: The company needs a strong brand identity.
ex.zh: 公司需要鮮明的品牌識別。

ex.en: Language is an important part of cultural identity.
ex.zh: 語言是文化認同的重要部分。

ex.en: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.
ex.zh: 溫暖的晴天最適合野餐。

ex.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
ex.zh: 海灘是孩子們玩耍的理想場所。

ex.en: He proved to be an ideal husband.
ex.zh: 結果證明他是個理想的丈夫。

ex.en: She has always had high ideals.
ex.zh: 她一向有崇高的理想。

ex.en: The company was founded on the ideal of equal opportunity.
ex.zh: 這家公司以機會平等的理想創立。

ex.en: Strong passwords can help prevent identity theft.
ex.zh: 使用高強度密碼有助於防止身分盜用。

ex.en: The bank contacted customers after an identity theft case.
ex.zh: 發生身分盜用案件後，銀行聯絡了客戶。
